items.title: Lifted admissibility
items.scope: The dependent/child least grammar with observational primitive witnesses derives typed successful-prefix safety, authentic original-index receipts and child retention for all nine rules. Per-step models establish admissibility without assumed successor invariants. MixedDriver and FreshDriver implement closed instructions and construct actual histories from empty; FreshDriver admits dynamic allocation and one owning pending admission, including landing Divert after intervening checked calls. Strict failure is an absent transition. These results do not establish the original full recursive-context strong witness: guarded Child success domains can distinguish equal observations. Arbitrary callbacks/Future internals and unrestricted interference remain open. The actual synchronous interpreter now states exact acceptance under its existing wf invariant: Mixed insertion requires a valid bank index, validity of the required bank prefix and the Kernel insertion domain; provider resolution and primitive execution each have independent success equivalences. Mixed/Fresh step succeeds iff a registered coherent Loading actor has a current instruction whose primitive domain holds and whose terminal effect completes publication. complete_after accounts for a Provide filling the final missing slot in this call. Fresh instantiates Child with the current next_id. Public step errors preserve the complete transactional same relation; internal execute/step_inner failures may have changed the draft. These are checked contracts on the same executable methods, not caller-supplied success premises or whole-run totality. The owning admitted protocol now also has exact local acceptance: FreshDriver::admit succeeds iff admission_enabled (the current ready predicate), without reserving values or child ports. Admission::selected_instruction retains the captured template and instantiates Child with the current allocator; land succeeds iff an unconsumed bound ticket has an enabled primitive and either target incoherence, a continuation, or complete_after for coherent terminal publication. Under its original premises commit_divert succeeds. Successful landing reports diverted exactly for input-state incoherence and any returned child equals the input machine next_id. Errors preserve the complete machine, ticket identity and consumed flag, so an unused ticket can be retried after checked calls make its domain valid; stale and consumed tickets remain rejected. These contracts characterize existing execution branches, not arbitrary Future completion or whole-run dynamic termination. Successful admission additionally establishes admitted.land_enabled() == the input machine's step_enabled(actor): immediate landing without an intervening operation has the synchronous step acceptance domain, while admission_enabled itself checks only the weaker ready condition. This domain equality does not reserve it against later calls. FreshDriver::run_until_blocked now performs an actual loop over transactional step under wf alone, without fuel, future-success assumptions or a supplied source trace. Its rank is the installed forward program's remaining code positions plus a possible terminal Unit, with one for a missing/invalid position. The u128 count records committed calls including the terminal call, excludes the first failed attempt and is bounded by the input run_budget; on error count+1 is bounded and the final actor is not step_enabled. Successful prefixes remain committed and only a failed step rolls back; zero committed steps preserve the complete machine under same. A no-error report establishes a registered Active actor with no current instruction; newly registered children remain Inactive and are not executed. RunReport::refines conditionally extends any well-formed source already represented by the input with exactly the actual successful calls, using an erased ghost source chain. The public proof method RunReport::advance_source extracts this execution under the established refines, input representation and source well-formedness premises for further composition. It does not establish source existence from arbitrary wf or an independent empty-origin execution. This is finite return for one synchronous installed program, not totality of strict primitives, guaranteed unblocking, global quiescence or the full dynamic-registry theorem. The real run_from_empty entry point now constructs a new machine, executes run_script and calls run_until_blocked only after all preparation commands succeed; it takes no input machine, source representation, fuel or future-success assumption. FromEmptyReport::refines establishes one source execution from empty representing both the actual prepared machine and the final machine, with every state well formed and resource_safe. source_execution extracts this witness; concatenate joins the preparation and autonomous executions at their identical boundary without a duplicate state or extra failure event. This establishes the conditional RunReport input premises for this path, not for arbitrary wf machines. SetupFailed preserves the successful preparation prefix and has zero autonomous steps without implying that the selected actor is blocked. Blocked and Finished describe the autonomous result only after successful preparation. The runtime setup vector records preparation transitions, while steps counts only committed autonomous calls including a terminal call; prepared snapshots and autonomous outcomes are erased ghost data. The exact implementation acceptance profile now covers Insert, Begin and Step via mixed_driver::fresh::preparation::preparation_command and FreshDriver::preparation_enabled. Fresh insertion_enabled reuses the Mixed blueprint/bank-prefix/Kernel insertion domain; begin_enabled includes registration, an empty retained journal and Kernel begin_enabled, including target availability and bounded generation capacity; Step retains step_enabled. FreshDriver::apply succeeds iff the current preparation predicate for commands in this profile. On a script error whose failed command is in the profile, run_script proves that command disabled in the returned machine; run_from_empty propagates this to both prepared and returned machines on SetupFailed. The predicate is evaluated at the actual failure state after the successful prefix, not for the whole script in the initial empty state, and the prefix may contain other commands. Retire/Depart/Unload/Remove remain supported: a false preparation_enabled result outside preparation_command is not a rejection claim. Dispatcher equivalences for those commands and individual error enum classifications remain outside this profile; the direct Unload domain is characterized separately below. This characterizes the implementation domain, including blueprint validity, finite capacity and strict value availability, rather than acceptance of every paper-enabled preparation command. Executable branches and error order are unchanged. Newly registered children remain Inactive; strict primitives may block. Multiple-actor/dynamic-child execution, the remaining preparation/recovery domains and the global rank remain open, so this from-empty execution result does not establish whole-system progress or complete this item. Public MixedDriver::unload and FreshDriver::unload now succeed iff unload_enabled: Kernel cleanup_enabled and restore_receipts of the actual retained journal in the current primitive state is Some. The latter recursively applies mixed_grammar::undo from last receipt to first, independently of the return result. Under its registered Unloading receipt-owner premises, actual undo_one succeeds iff its modeled inverse is defined, produces that state on success, preserves its own input on failure and preserves Kernel restoring flags. This does not derive inverse definedness from arbitrary wf, cleanup permission or !relied, and it does not establish general foreign-replay observation equivalence, arbitrary external-resource restoration or whole-system progress. Child inverses retire captured identities without removing them or running their cleanup. The preparation dispatcher success-equivalence profile remains only Insert/Begin/Step. These are exact execution-domain and finite-call guarantees within the existing strict grammar, not completion of the unrestricted paper theorem. For the actual retained Unit/Child fragment, unit_child_recovery.rs now connects each concrete receipt through represents to its authentic source token and derives captured-child registration from retained. restore_unit_children then proves that the entire real LIFO inverse sequence is defined, preserving the registry domain, tables and every registered node phase/commitment; it assumes neither restore success nor a future child cleanup. unit_child_recovery is derived from the source history constructed by Mixed/Fresh run_script, and for both the prepared and final machines returned by Fresh run_from_empty, including failed prefixes. Combining it with the actual Unit/Child journal classification eliminates the extra inverse-domain premise from public unload: success is exactly the existing Kernel cleanup guard. Both apply dispatchers expose the Unload success equivalence; a failed script Unload in this fragment establishes that cleanup is not permitted in the returned machine. The preparation-command profile remains Insert/Begin/Step, and bootstrap does not add a SetupFailed Unload diagnosis. The runtime journal, transaction behavior and removal retention guard are unchanged. Provision/Xor inverses, general Lemma57 context membership, Corollary69 foreign-replay observational equality and global termination remain outside this result.
